captions.detailed: A medieval stone-throwing bombard featuring a dark, wide cast-iron barrel resting in a fixed brown wooden bed cradle. The barrel is supported by side cheeks and pivots on a horizontal elevation revolute joint, allowing it to tilt up and down. A small, hinged rectangular touch-hole cover plate is located at the top rear of the barrel breech, rotating on its own revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a medieval stone-throwing bombard. It should feature a thick, dark cast-iron barrel with a hinged touch-hole cover plate on top, supported by a wooden bed cradle with side brackets that allow the barrel to pivot vertically.
captions.factory: Construct the wooden bed cradle assembly using box primitives for the base beams, cross-members, and vertical side cheeks. Model the cast-iron barrel using a series of concentric cylinders and cones to form the wide muzzle, central shaft, and breech section. Add the horizontal trunnions as cylinders on the barrel sides, and attach a hinged rectangular box at the breech top for the touch-hole cover. Define two revolute joints: one for the horizontal elevation axis of the barrel relative to the cradle side cheeks, and a second for the touch-hole cover hinge on top of the barrel.
